Es la reunion del productor de origen Hawaiiano  Dan "The automator" Nakamura, Dj QBert y el MC Kool Keith (Keith Matthew Thornton) centrados en los E.U. podcast.title: Historical Significance in Rap
podcast.body: Dr. Octagon is recognized as one of the most significant figures in the history of rap. His influential work has been sampled by major artists. "doctor octagon es una de las figuras más importantes también de la historia del rap."

podcast.title: Sampling by The Prodigy
podcast.body: Dr. Octagon's track "Change My Pitch Up" was sampled by The Prodigy for their song "Smack My Bitch Up." This demonstrates the widespread impact and importance of Dr. Octagon's music. "cuando de prodigíces mecmybicha realmente están samplando a doctor octagon con la canción change mybicha."
